title: Snowsports School Notice Periods, Retained Shares and Weather Bases
content:
The free cancellation period, the share retained on a late cancellation, the share retained for a missed session, the lag before a missed session is charged, the basis on which a session lost to the mountain is made good, and the number of business days within which a settled refund reaches the household's payment method are published against every Snowsports School product.

| Product | Free cancellation period (hours) | Late cancellation share | Missed session share | Assessment lag (calendar days) | Weather basis | Refund processing (business days) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 24 | 50.00 percent | 100.00 percent | 1 | full credit | 7 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 48 | 50.00 percent | 100.00 percent | 1 | full credit | 7 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 48 | 50.00 percent | 100.00 percent | 1 | full refund | 7 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 168 | 25.00 percent | 50.00 percent | 2 | partial credit | 10 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 48 | 50.00 percent | 100.00 percent | 1 | full credit | 7 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 72 | 50.00 percent | 100.00 percent | 1 | full refund | 7 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 336 | 40.00 percent | 60.00 percent | 2 | partial credit | 14 |

The free cancellation period is stated in whole hours before the scheduled start of the first session. The late cancellation share is the percentage of the booking price retained where a cancellation is recorded after that deadline; the missed session share is the percentage retained where the participant does not present for the session. The assessment lag is the number of calendar days after the scheduled session before a missed session is charged. The weather basis is what the household receives where the collective cancels the session for weather or mountain conditions, and is one of full credit, full refund or partial credit.

## Notes on the schedule

- The free cancellation period runs from 24 hours on the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson to 336 hours on the Elite Performance Camp, which is fourteen days of notice.
- Five of the seven products retain 50.00 percent on a late cancellation; the Six-Week Development Programme retains 25.00 percent and the Elite Performance Camp 40.00 percent.
- The Mountain Cubs Group Lesson and the Private Instruction Full Day carry a weather basis of full refund; the All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson, the Mountain Explorers Group Lesson and the Semi-Private Coaching Session carry full credit; the Six-Week Development Programme and the Elite Performance Camp carry partial credit.
- The two products carrying an assessment lag of 2 calendar days are the same two that carry a partial credit weather basis.
- A settled refund reaches the household's payment method within 7 business days on five products, 10 on the Six-Week Development Programme and 14 on the Elite Performance Camp.
